## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leafpop)
library(targets)

source(here::here("add-carto-tiles.R"))

tar_source()  # load all R/ functions, including dmcp_manual_matches()
tar_load(c(ice_office_nodes, ice_office_nodes_es,
           facility_roster, vera_facilities, ero_canonical))
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
cat("ice_nodes:", nrow(ice_office_nodes), "offices\n")
cat("ice_nodes:", nrow(ice_office_nodes_es), "offices from Spanish-language website\n" )
cat("facility_roster:", nrow(facility_roster), "facilities\n")
cat("vera_facilities:", nrow(vera_facilities), "facilities\n")
```

```{r}

# Better approach: cross-reference by (city + state), then check address similarity
# This avoids false positives from suite-number differences

# Build a lookup: city+state → roster facilities
roster_by_loc <- facility_roster |>
  mutate(
    city_upper  = str_to_upper(str_trim(facility_city)),
    state_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(facility_state))
  )
```

Most Spanish ICE nodes have the same addresses as English ICE nodes. There are `r ice_office_nodes_es |> filter((zip %in% ice_office_nodes$zip)) |>   filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes$address_line1)) |> nrow()` such cases.

Visually, we compare those ICE nodes with the same ZIP code and different address text nd see they are the same offices.

However, there are `r ice_office_nodes_es |> filter(!(zip %in% ice_office_nodes$zip)) |> filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes$address_line1))` cases with novel ZIP codes. We add these to our English list to run the analysis.

```{r ice-language-combination}
# Most addresses are the same
ice_office_nodes_es |> filter((zip %in% ice_office_nodes$zip)) |>
  filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes$address_line1)) |> nrow()

# Spanish and English ICE nodes with shared ZIP
ice_office_nodes_es |> 
  filter((zip %in% ice_office_nodes$zip)) |> 
  filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes$address_line1))
ice_office_nodes |> 
  filter((zip %in% ice_office_nodes_es$zip)) |> 
  filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes_es$address_line1))

# Spanish ICE nodes with novel ZIP codes and addresses
ice_office_nodes_es_novel <- ice_office_nodes_es |> 
  filter(!(zip %in% ice_office_nodes$zip)) |> 
  filter(!(address_line1 %in% ice_office_nodes$address_line1))

ice_office_nodes_es_novel 

ice_nodes <- bind_rows(ice_office_nodes, ice_office_nodes_es_novel)

```

```{r}
# For each ice node, check if any roster facility shares city+state
ice_with_roster <- ice_nodes |>
  mutate(
    city_upper  = str_to_upper(str_trim(city)),
    state_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(state))
  ) |>
  left_join(
    roster_by_loc |> 
      select(canonical_id, canonical_name, facility_address, facility_city,
             facility_state, detloc, facility_type_wiki, city_upper, state_upper),
    by = c("city_upper", "state_upper"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

# Now filter to cases where the street address actually matches
# (first word of street number and name)
matched <- ice_with_roster |>
  filter(!is.na(canonical_id)) |>
  mutate(
    node_street   = str_to_upper(str_trim(address_line1)),
    roster_street = str_to_upper(str_trim(facility_address)),
    # Check if the node street appears in the roster street or vice versa
    street_match = str_detect(roster_street, fixed(node_street, ignore_case = TRUE)) |
                   str_detect(node_street, fixed(roster_street, ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  filter(street_match)

not_matched <- ice_nodes |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    city_upper  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(city)),
    state_upper = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(state)),
    node_street = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(address_line1))
    ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!node_id %in% matched$node_id)

cat("City+state+street matches:", nrow(matched), "\n\n")
matched |>
  select(page_title, field_office_name, address_line1, city, state,
         canonical_id, canonical_name, facility_type_wiki, detloc) 
```

```{r vera-matches}

# Cross-reference all 110 ice nodes against vera_facilities by state + street
vera_by_state <- vera_facilities |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    vera_street  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_extract(facility_address, "^[^,]+") |> stringr::str_trim()),
    state_upper  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(facility_state))
  )

ice_nodes_vera <- ice_nodes |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state_upper = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(state))
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    vera_by_state |>
      dplyr::select(detloc, facility_name, facility_address, facility_city, facility_state,
                    type_grouped_corrected, vera_street, state_upper),
    by = "state_upper",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(detloc)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    node_street  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(address_line1)),
    street_match = stringr::str_detect(vera_street, stringr::fixed(node_street, ignore_case = TRUE)) |
                   stringr::str_detect(node_street, stringr::fixed(vera_street, ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(street_match)

cat("ICE nodes matched to Vera:", nrow(ice_nodes_vera), "\n")

# Full Vera match table
ice_nodes_vera |>
  dplyr::select(page_title, field_office_name, address_line1, city, state,
                detloc, facility_name, type_grouped_corrected)

# Summary: which of the 65 "unmatched to roster" are in Vera?
unmatched_in_vera <- not_matched |>
  dplyr::filter(node_id %in% ice_nodes_vera$node_id)
cat("\nOf the 65 unmatched to roster,", nrow(unmatched_in_vera), "are in Vera\n")

# True unknowns: not in roster, not in vera
true_unknowns <- not_matched |>
  dplyr::filter(!node_id %in% ice_nodes_vera$node_id)
cat("True unknowns (not in roster or Vera):", nrow(true_unknowns), "\n")

unmatched_vs_ero <- not_matched |> 
  dplyr::left_join(ero_canonical |> 
     dplyr::mutate(
         city_upper  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(city)),
         state_upper = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(state)),
         ero_street  = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_trim(address))
         ) |>
  dplyr::select(canonical_id, canonical_name, address, 
                city, state, detloc, city_upper, state_upper, ero_street),
                by = c("city_upper", "state_upper"),
                relationship = "many-to-many",
                suffix = c("_node", "_ero")
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(canonical_id)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    street_match = stringr::str_detect(ero_street,stringr::fixed(node_street, ignore_case = TRUE)) |
      stringr::str_detect(node_street, stringr::fixed(ero_street, ignore_case = TRUE))
    ) |>
  dplyr::filter(street_match)
```

```{r match-summary}

# Final summary table
cat("=== ICE Office Node Coverage Summary ===\n\n")
cat("Total ICE office nodes (node range 62000-62300):", nrow(ice_nodes), "\n\n")

cat("IN facility_roster (by city+state+street):", nrow(matched), "\n")
cat("  Of these, in Vera:", sum(matched$node_id %in% ice_nodes_vera$node_id), "\n")
cat("  Of these, NOT in Vera:", sum(!matched$node_id %in% ice_nodes_vera$node_id), "\n\n")

cat("NOT in facility_roster:", nrow(not_matched), "\n")
cat("  In Vera (potential new roster entries):", nrow(unmatched_in_vera), "\n")
# cat("    Of these, matched to ERO canonical:", nrow(unmatched_vs_ero2), "\n")
cat("  Not in Vera or roster (truly new):", nrow(true_unknowns), "\n\n")

cat("True unknowns - not in roster or Vera:\n")
true_unknowns |>
  dplyr::select(page_title, field_office_name, address_line1, city, state) |>
  arrange(state, city)
```
